title: Construction of a Near-Infrared Luminescent 48-Metal Rectangular Zn(II)–Yb(III) Nanocluster with Carbonate Templates for the Dual-Emissive Detection of Rutin as a Medicinal Ingredient

synthesis.procedure: Triethylamine (1 mL of a 1.0 mol L−1 solution in methanol) was added to H2L, ytterbium acetate hexahydrate, and zinc triflate tetrahydrate in methanol, ethanol, and DMF. The mixture was stirred at reflux for 2 h in air and filtered at room temperature. Vapor diffusion of diethyl ether into the clear filtrate for 1 month gave yellow crystals of 1.

properties.summary: Compound 1 has visible ligand-centered emission and near-infrared Yb(III) emission. Rutin quenches the former and enhances the latter, enabling rapid dual-emissive detection in acetonitrile and fetal calf serum.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The approximately 1.3 × 2.8 × 3.1 nm rectangular cluster consists of two equivalent Zn11Yb13 moieties bridged by two Schiff-base ligands. Within each moiety, a carbonate template bridges a Zn2Yb5 core; hydroxide and acetate bridges connect that core to the remaining metal ions.
